key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How does trade affect a person's intellect according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that engaging in trade develops a person's intellect. The hadith highlights the positive moral and practical value of lawful economic activity in cultivating sound judgment and understanding.
